solutionSource.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

entries.clue: Meat, raw, dropping back on centigrade scale (7,2)

indicatorNotes.dropping back: falling back the way it came, so PURE reads backwards
indicatorNotes.on: in an across clue, one piece placed on another comes after it, so C goes first

blocks.note: C = centigrade, on thermometers
lamb is a meat
raw spirit is pure, unmixed; PURE backwards

annotation.surface: A cook watches raw meat drop back on a thermometer scale.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Scale' looks like the thermometer's scale of degrees; it is a verb, to climb.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym for the verb: to scale a wall is to climb it hand over hand.

entries.clue: Perhaps change nothing more than is material (8)

blocks.note: loose change is one kind of cash; 'perhaps' marks the example
a mere child = nothing more than a child

annotation.surface: A shrug: perhaps changing nothing more than what matters.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Material' reads as the adjective, relevant; it is a noun, cloth.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by category: cashmere is a fine wool cloth from the Kashmir goat.

entries.clue: Old commander elected as before (5)

blocks.note: an aga was an Ottoman commander
a party elected is in

annotation.surface: A former commander is voted back in, just as before.
annotation.walkthrough: An aga (or agha) was a military commander in the Ottoman Empire.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: doing something once more repeats what happened before.

entries.clue: Slight depression in the middle of one’s corporation? (5,6)

annotation.definition: Slight depression in the middle of one’s corporation?

annotation.surface: A company's midpoint is having a slight economic dip.
annotation.walkthrough: Both halves pull toward business: a depression is a slump and a corporation a firm. Read physically, they describe the navel.

a secret exposed is out

annotation.definitionFit: A definition by category: a ragout is a rich French stew, one kind of dish.

a look = a view

entries.clue: Great resources (7)

the money and assets a business has to work with

to net a fish is to catch it

Thomas More wrote Utopia
to flag something is to draw attention to it

as written

the middle of hUGe

entries.clue: Dieting’s ending with an itch for something chocolatey (7)

a bout is a match, as in boxing

entries.clue: Something green of blue I stirred (7)

blocks.note: the letters of OF BLUE I rearranged

entries.clue: Hardy novel is entirely lacking in the end (9)

annotation.walkthrough: 'Hardy novel' reads as Thomas Hardy's fiction; 'Hardy' is the adjective, the definition, and 'novel' the anagram signal.

annotation.walkthrough: The egg is figurative, a villain; the apple is literal, and it has a core.

the first and last letters of ElusivE
